practice.prompt: Solve (x − 25)(x + 5) = 0. Give every solution and check the zero-product rule.
practice.memo: The product is zero, so at least one factor must equal zero.. First factor: x − 25 = 0, therefore x = 25.. Second factor: x + 5 = 0, therefore x = -5.. Check: (25 − 25)(25 + 5) = 0 and (-5 − 25)(-5 + 5) = 0.
